review: The Ring Fauvist Docent Rodion (shortened to Ring Rodion) is a Bleed-centric ID with a touch of Sinking that utilizes the main gimmick of The Ring, which is to inflict as many unique negative status effects onto the enemy as possible. This is supported by the effects that the Fauvist brings, which are: - Mauled Color [Rouge] - This effect inflicts bonus Bleed Potency on hit (three maximum) and up to 2 Defense Level Down at the end of turns. - Mauled Color [Bleu] - This effect does effectively the same as Rouge, but the enemy gains Sinking Potency instead. Instead of Defense Level Down, this effect will make the target lose 5 SP as well. - Touche Hardie - This effect will make the target take +10% HP and SP damage from Bleed and Sinking effects, for a maximum of 20% bonus damage on both. - Palette Vibrante - This effect comes from Rodion’s passive when Mauled Colors [Rouge] & [Bleu], as w
